verdict.rationale: First-party docs call Convex an "open source" database. The self-hosting docs say self-hosted Convex runs the open-source backend, with the same up-to-date code the cloud service uses. A public GitHub repository (get-convex/convex-backend) is cited, and Components are also described as open-source. missing for 10: the specific open license is never named in the evidence, no evidence that the full product surface (dashboard, client libraries) is open, and no independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
